title: The Iron Downs' 'declare the miners' hall's claim' resolution is explicitly softer than the other two hollow-rests ('The Hundred do not rest, exactly — but they are minded now, not abandoned'), which is a nice nuance, but nothing on the choice menu itself flagged that this option was categorically different in kind from 'speak the truth' or 'bring the gallery down' before picking it.
